observations: Photo 0 shows a black standing fan with a circular metal grille and three blades, placed on a marble floor against a white paneled wall.
The fan's motor housing has a visible label with the brand name 'Binatone' and model 'BA-OS-1280'.
Photo 1 is a similar angle, showing the same fan with the power cord coiled around the top of the grille.
The fan appears clean and intact, with no visible dents or cracks in the base or grille.
The stand is straight, and the base is stable-looking.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the Binatone brand name and model BA-OS-1280 on the motor housing label.
Photos show no obvious damage, but no signs of wear or usage are visible. No close-ups of the motor, switch, or cord insulation.

claims.claim: Very neat and in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show a clean, intact fan with no visible damage to the grille, blades, or base.

risks.risk: The fan may not work or may have internal damage (e.g., motor, capacitor, switch)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the fan turning on and oscillating, or a close-up of the power switch and cord insulation.

risks.risk: The fan may have hidden wear or damage not visible in photos (e.g., loose blades, wobbling base, damaged motor housing)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the motor housing, base, and blade connections, and a video of the fan in operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or noisy

proof_requests: Video of the fan turning on and oscillating.
Close-up of the power switch and cord insulation.
Close-up of the motor housing and blade connections.
response.reason: The brand and model are confirmed, but the functional condition and hidden wear cannot be verified from the photos alone. The fan must be shown operating to confirm it works, and close-ups are needed to check for internal damage or wear.
